question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
SELECT w1.name AS winner_name, w2.name AS loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = CAST(b.id AS TEXT)
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = CAST(w1.id AS TEXT)
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = CAST(w2.id AS TEXT)
WHERE b.name LIKE 'NXT%' AND m.title_change = 0 AND m.duration != '' AND m.duration IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.duration ASC
LIMIT 1
